name: Aesop First Wave Replay Kit
description: A verified baseline example wave demonstrating the full cycle: dispatch, implementation, testing, and merge

items.prompt: Fix the typo in README.md where 'orchestration' is misspelled as 'orchestraion'. Verify the file has exactly one instance and replace it. This is a simple one-line fix to demonstrate a trivial dispatch cycle.
items.testCmd: grep -q 'orchestration' README.md && ! grep -q 'orchestraion' README.md && echo 'Fix verified'

items.prompt: In tests/test_example.js, find the test marked with .skip (e.g., 'it.skip(...)') and remove the .skip to enable it. This test validates basic functionality and should run. Include a comment explaining why it was re-enabled.
items.testCmd: grep -q 'it.skip' tests/test_example.js && echo 'Still skipped' || (npm test 2>&1 | grep -q 'passing' && echo 'Tests run')

items.prompt: Create or update .eslintrc.json with a basic ESLint configuration for the project (use airbnb or standard preset). Update package.json to add an 'npm run lint' script that runs eslint on src/ and tests/. Ensure package.json linting passes.

Review docs/ARCHITECTURE.md and docs/SETUP.md for broken or relative links. Fix any links that point to non-existent files or use incorrect paths. Ensure all cross-document references are correct and follow the docs/ index structure.
items.testCmd: test -f docs/ARCHITECTURE.md && test -f docs/SETUP.md && echo 'Doc files present'

items.prompt: In src/utils/helpers.js, refactor two or more utility functions to reduce duplication or improve readability (e.g., consolidate similar functions, extract common logic, improve naming). Update the corresponding test file (src/utils/helpers.test.js) to verify all refactored functions still pass. Include a docstring comment explaining the refactor goal.
